Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Smita Desai. I am a 25-year-old electrician living in Chennai. I have a tenancy problem with Debashish More involving 4.8 lakh rupees in rent, and the tenant has stopped paying rent for many months. My case number is R.C.A. No. 2063/2025 in the Chennai District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 08131867094 or email smita.desai@example.in.
